reason: In apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx:42-45, onError constructs message as the template literal `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`, which always contains ': ' and is never falsy, so the `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback is never reached. Users therefore always see raw tRPC code prefixes and untranslated keys/messages (for example, 'FORBIDDEN: you_do_not_have_permission' from packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:55, which has no entry in apps/web/public/static/locales/en/common.json).
